notes.note: Bounded delta review of § TurnDeduplicator Code and evidence plus the new Direct chat claim lifecycle text at b9bf8eaa5e3; the merge base e60affce10e already carries the #4184 floor. Source-traced: chat-primary-stream pre-stream claim and 409; invokeAgent abort check, then beginInvocation, then agent.streamText inside the native relay guard (admission, configuration lease, active Agent, spec); finally resolve/retain/release; chat-turn-dedup facade; EventStore retainChatTurn (sole event-store.ts delta, a 3-line delegate); TurnIdempotencyStore claim/givenUp/retain (at most 4,096 process-local markers); awaitTurnResolution (5-minute default); SQLite floor equal to cap. The stale in-process-failure-releases sentence is gone. Confirmed: a drained, non-aborted stream resolves whatever its finish label. Post-call outcomes retain, including tail disconnect and a thrown resolve. A non-applied resolve is undetected. The owning process answers 409; other processes contend and wait in-stream, then error. A dead owner past invocation gives a durable refusal. An expired key answers 409 under tombstone limits. Replay is a generic completed with no output. The key is unscoped and undigested (#3567). A pre-call refusal leaves conversation residue. Disconnect aborts the turn. There is no exactly-once effect or durable continuation. Unresolved rows are unbounded; the resolved floor protects only a count. Recovery advice inspects the conversation and forbids automatic new-key resend. The test descriptions were checked against test names and modes only; pass and mutation results are implementer-supplied, not re-run. Other module sections and other cited sources were not reviewed.
